p2g3.instruction: Complete the following summary of the paragraphs of the Reading Passage. Use NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the Reading Passage for each answer.
p2g3.body: The Great Eastern was specially designed with a [[23]] for carrying more fuels and was to take a long voyage to [[24]]. However, due to physical condition, Brunel could not go with the maiden voyage. Actually, the Great Eastern was unprofitable and the great ship never crossed [[25]]. But soon after there was an ironic opportunity for the Great Eastern, which was used to carry and to lay huge [[26]] on the Atlantic Ocean floor.
